articles.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
articles.snippet: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

articles.title: Live news: Crypto prices give ground even as stocks and gold surge, oil plunges
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq, S&P 500, and DJIA all closed more than 2% higher despite Nvidia's steep decline on CEO Jensen Huang's personal issues.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.snippet: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.
